segments.he:
תּוֹרָה קח
כְּשֶׁאָדָם מִתְפַּלֵּל כָּרָאוּי בִּדְבֵקוּת אוֹ מִתְבּוֹדֵד כָּרָאוּי, וּבֶאֶמְצַע הוּא נוֹפֵל מִמַּדְרֵגָתוֹ, זֶה נִמְשָׁךְ מִפְּגַם אֱמוּנָה. וְאָז צָרִיךְ שֶׁיְּשַׁבֵּר לִבּוֹ בְּקִרְבּוֹ וְיִתְבַּיֵּשׁ בְּעַצְמוֹ עַל שֶׁנָּפַל וְנִשְׁלַךְ מִשָּׁמַיִם לָאָרֶץ, וִירַחֵם עַל עַצְמוֹ עַד שֶׁיִּתְאַנֵּחַ עַל זֶה, וְעַל־יְדֵי הָאֲנָחָה יַחֲזֹר לְמַדְרֵגָתוֹ:
segments.en: Through lighting the Chanukah candle and through the hallel and thanksgiving of Chanukah — which is the primary delight of the World to Come as above — through this one merits also that all three lines of truth will illuminate in all four aspects of speech as above — and complete the speech. And through this one will merit to draw the holiness and joy of Shabbos into the six weekdays. And through this His simple unity will be revealed from within the varied actions as above. Fortunate is one who merits to such a Chanukah — to draw all these awesome rectifications.
